transcript.content: Hello, how are you today? What brings you in to see me?

I’m… okay, I guess. I’m here because I keep making myself throw up after I eat. Sometimes at work, in the bathroom, or when I get home. It’s embarrassing, but it feels like the only thing that calms me down sometimes.
Do you find yourself very concerned about your weight or the way your body looks, especially before or after eating?
Yeah… I do. I don’t really like talking about it, but even if I’m doing okay at work, if I see myself in the glass and my stomach or hips look big, I just… I feel like I failed somehow.
Do you judge yourself mainly based on your body shape or weight?
Yeah… mostly, I think. Like, I can be doing fine at the shop, and then I catch my reflection in the glass and if my stomach or hips look big to me, I just feel like I failed.
Do you ever feel like you lose control over how much you eat, like you can’t stop eating once you start, or that you’re eating a lot more than other people would in a short period of time?
Yeah… sometimes. Once I start eating, it’s like my hands just keep going back for more, even when I’m telling myself to stop. I feel kind of like I’m watching it happen and I can’t make myself quit.
After you feel like you’ve eaten too much, do you ever make yourself throw up, use laxatives, or exercise a lot more than usual to try to make up for it?

Yeah… I do. I make myself throw up after I eat sometimes. It’s… hard to say. Sometimes it’s at work, in the bathroom, or as soon as I get home. It feels like the only thing that makes me calm down after.
